Subject: CIO participation + short window for Nimbus pilot demo

Hi Lucas / Amira —

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. We'd like to lock in a short, focused pilot demo of Redwood inference for the Nimbus workload. Based on the schedule you mentioned, you had a tight window the week of July 26 with your CIO available between 10:00–11:00 PT for a brief exec walkthrough.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Amira confirm whether she prefers to join the live demo for the first 20 minutes (high-level exec view) or to receive a 10–15 minute follow-up summary with the recorded excerpt?
- If the live attendance is preferred, will the CIO join as a watcher only or participate for Q&A? We want to tailor the agenda.

I attached an updated mutual action plan with suggested attendees and timeboxes. If it helps, here's my Calendly to pick an exact slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-30min?month=2027-07

Thanks — looking to finalize before Wednesday so engineering can confirm capacity.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Karthik —

Thanks for the plan and the quick turnaround. Amira is tied up in a board review on the 26th but can do a hard 30-minute block on Tue 27 Jul at 10:30 PT; otherwise she prefers we take the recording and do a 15-minute recap with her on Wed.

She asked that the demo include a 10-minute section that calls out latency/cost tradeoffs (our infra team is most focused there). If you can keep the exec portion to 20 minutes and then open for a technical deep-dive for our infra folks that would be ideal.

Also attaching our signed NDA for your records.

Adding a quick internal note —

Karthik: Tue 27 Jul 10:30 PT works for me as the exec portion. I'll cover the 10-minute latency/cost slide with a tight appendix for infra. Suggest agenda: 0–20m exec (high level value, data residency, SLA), 20–50m infra deep-dive (throughput, batching, KV cache), 50–60m next steps & M.A.P.

Sofia: would you be able to lead the infra deep-dive? If not, we should loop in Dev Patel. Also, can we pre-record the 10–minute latency comparison so Amira can reference it later if she needs to step out?

Karthik — I'll draft the invite, include zoom recording enabled, and attach the MAP and the 2–3 slides the infra team will want.

All — confirmed: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:30–11:30 PT (Zoom) for exec + tech deep-dive. Zoom invite sent to all (recording enabled).

Notes for the session:
- Exec portion (Karthik / Marissa): high-level benefits, rollout model, key SLOs.
- Infra deep-dive (Sofia): throughput bench, batching strategy, quantization options, and a 10-minute appendix comparing latency/cost at 1k vs 8k tokens. I'll include a short recorded clip of the latency slides at start of the meeting for Amira to keep.
- Outcome: agree mutual action items, sign-off on pilot scope, and confirm Redwood Dedicated sizing if pilot goes to production.

Attachments: infra-latency-comparison.pptx (slide deck), Orion_MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf
